description: Defines the BuzzPost entity class for the OrangeHRM system, representing a social media post with properties like employee, text, timestamps, photos, and links.

classes.name: BuzzPost
classes.description: Entity class representing a social media post within the OrangeHRM system, including properties for employee, content, timestamps, photos, and links.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the BuzzPost.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the BuzzPost.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Returns the Employee associated with the post.

methods.name: setEmployee
methods.description: Associates an Employee with the post.

methods.name: getText
methods.description: Returns the text content of the post.

methods.name: setText
methods.description: Sets the text content of the post.

methods.name: getCreatedAtUtc
methods.description: Returns the creation timestamp in UTC.

methods.name: setCreatedAtUtc
methods.description: Sets the creation timestamp to current UTC time.

methods.name: getUpdatedAtUtc
methods.description: Returns the last updated timestamp in UTC.

methods.name: setUpdatedAtUtc
methods.description: Updates the last modified timestamp to current UTC time.
